text: 8月股债融资占比超50%，宏观政策将继续加码促经济 企业债券在社融规模增量中占比升至11.67%，较上年同期提升5.8个百分点。
text_en: Equity and bond financing accounted for over 50% in August, macro policy will continue to step up to boost the economy. Corporate bonds' share of incremental aggregate social financing rose to 11.67%, up 5.8 percentage points from a year earlier.
